trigger.description: Restore or preview an authenticated legacy backup containing memories whose trust-history carrier is absent or uses v1 without memory provenance. Recovery imports the memories with missing commitments and does not create or verify replacement provenance hashes.
setup_commands: # Select the original source workspace and an authenticated legacy backup created without a v2 memory-provenance carrier.

expected_emission.repair_string: Recreate a private backup from the original workspace with a current binary to preserve provenance history; review source provenance before treating recovered memories as verified.
